newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY UNION-WALLABIES NAME ONLY ONE CHANGE FOR NZ.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WALLABIES NAME ONLY ONE CHANGE FOR NZ.

text.p: Australia on Wednesday announced only one change to the Wallabies for the first Bledisloe Cup match against New Zealand in Christchurch on Saturday, despite injury woes after last week's second test defeat of France.

The only change to the starting team which completed a 2-0 series sweep against France was the inclusion of young Queensland second rower Matt Cockbain coming in for David Giffin who suffered a broken foot in training on Tuesday.
More importantly, centre Jason Little, replaced in the second half against France because of a serious hip muscle injury, was named in the team.
Coach Greg Smith said he would give Little until Friday to prove his fitness, with Daniel Herbert on standby.
Winger Ben Tune was still being troubled by a hamstring strain and David Wilson was suffering hip and rib soreness after the 26-19 win against France last Saturday.

Australia - 15-Stephen Larkham; 14-Ben Tune, 13-Jason Little, 12-Pat Howard, 11-Joe Roff; 10-Tim Horan, 9-George Gregan; 8-Troy Coker, 7-David Wilson, 6-Brett Robinson, 5-John Eales (captain), 4-Matt Cockbain, 3-Ewen McKenzie, 2-Marco Caputo, 1-Richard Harry.
Substitutes - Mitch Hardy, Daniel Herbert, James Holbeck, Sam Payne, Garrick Morgan, Toutai Kefu, Daniel Manu, Michael Foley, Andrew Blades.
